patch.value: GH-1078: Complete-list certification accepts absent or contradictory truth receipts and emits stale recovery

The public certifyCompleteListResult SDK primitive in 2026.8.21 can issue a complete_list certificate when omission_receipt or read_output is absent, when completeness reports unreadable rows, or when omission fields contradict has_omissions=false. PmCompleteListValidationError also recommends deprecated list-all recovery without the current unbounded output-limit/include controls. This is the GitHub #1078 follow-on to the shipped fail-closed complete-list lineage in pm-y4aaol and belongs under the SDK-first architecture epic pm-usfg.

Require completeness.status=complete with safe-integer zero unreadable counts; require omission_receipt has_omissions=false, safe-integer zero count, and empty groups; require read_output contract v1 for list with within_budget=true, no compaction or omission, and complete include/amount/cost dimensions; reject output budget truncation/exceeded disclosures; return stable independent finding codes with absent, malformed, contradictory, and nonzero negative controls; emit canonical executable current recovery and prove it in a fresh-tracker acceptance test

Obtain the real pm list --all strict unbounded JSON envelope, then independently delete omission_receipt, contradict its count/groups, delete read_output, or set completeness unreadable_item_count=1; certifyCompleteListResult currently accepts each mutated envelope. Inspect PmCompleteListValidationError.recovery.suggested_retry for stale list-all syntax.

Certification fails closed unless completeness, omission_receipt, and read_output independently prove complete unbounded delivery with stable finding codes; budget truncation disclosures are rejected; the canonical suggested retry uses list --all, output-include full, output-budget unbounded, and output-limit unbounded and executes successfully in a fresh tracker.
Missing or contradictory truth receipts are accepted and certified; recovery suggests pm list-all --full --strict-read --no-truncate --output-budget unbounded --json.
